name: Hidden Edge: Credential Reuse
description: An inferred attack path reviewed by the operator, not a declared flow: a credential the source holds is accepted by the target (ATT&CK T1078, T1550, T1552): a path the model does not declare as a flow. Dethereal writes a flow of this class when the operator accepts a hidden-edge candidate; it is never the class of an ordinary data flow.
